rows.label: Type
rows.value: 4-cylinder in-line, 4-stroke diesel, liquid cooled, indirect injection

rows.label: Combustion system
rows.value: Indirect injection with Ricardo Comet pre-combustion chambers (separate insert in the head)

rows.label: Cylinder liners
rows.value: Removable flanged sleeves, withdrawn upwards with the pistons; graded F/G/H, standard size only (no rebore). Wet or dry not stated by the manual; other sources conflict

rows.label: Power (bare engine)
rows.value: 37.25 bhp; 35.9 belt hp; 34 hp at the PTO; 31.5 drawbar hp

rows.label: Injection pump
rows.value: CAV DPA distributor pump with integral variable-speed governor. Codes 3240011/12/13/15 timed 19° BTDC; 3242643/3242645 (light-load advance) timed 13° BTDC

rows.label: Injectors
rows.value: CAV Pintaux; nozzle type changes at engine numbers SJ 86046E and SJ 125725E. Working pressure 130 atm (new setting 135 atm)

rows.label: Valve clearance (cold)
rows.value: Inlet 0.305 mm (0.012 in), exhaust 0.203 mm (0.008 in)

rows.label: Valve timing
rows.value: IO 10½° BTDC, IC 37½° ABDC, EO 45½° BBDC, EC 10½° ATDC (checked at 0.015 in clearance)

rows.label: Oil pressure
rows.value: 40–60 lb/sq in (2.8–4.2 kg/sq cm); rotor pump at engine speed

rows.label: Fuel lift pump
rows.value: AC type YD, driven by an eccentric at the rear of the camshaft; 4–7 lb/sq in

rows.label: Cold-start equipment
rows.value: CAV Thermostart in the inlet manifold, or Ki-gass equipment

sections.explainer: Figures are lb ft as printed in the workshop manual (SRC-035 B.29–B.30). Multiply by 1.356 for Nm. Earlier figures from a supplier website (SRC-006) mixed up units and have been replaced.

rows.label: Clutch options
rows.value: Single dry disc 10 in (254 mm) on the diesel, or dual clutch: 11 in (279.4 mm) transmission disc and 9 in (228.6 mm) PTO/hydraulic pump disc with 2 Belleville springs

rows.label: Dual-stage action
rows.value: First stage releases the gearbox drive only; the pump and PTO keep running. Second stage releases both

rows.label: Clutch pedal free movement
rows.value: Single clutch 3/4 in (19 mm); dual clutch 3/8 in (9.5 mm)

rows.label: Gearbox
rows.value: 6 forward, 2 reverse (3 speeds and reverse × high/low range)

rows.label: Controls
rows.value: Left lever 1–3 and reverse; right lever high / low / neutral 'start' position

sections.title: Power take-off

rows.label: Speed
rows.value: 540 rpm at 1,500 engine rpm (720 rpm at 2,000)

rows.label: Ground-speed setting
rows.value: About 1 shaft revolution per 20 in (508 mm) of rear-wheel travel

rows.label: Drive
rows.value: Through the clutch with a single clutch (stops with the pedal); live via the second clutch stage with a dual clutch

rows.label: Shaft size and splines
rows.value: 6 splines, major diameter 1.371–1.373 in (34.8 mm), minor 1.098–1.108 in

sections.explainer: Power path: engine → flywheel → clutch. With a single clutch, the gearbox and the PTO/pump drive both run off the one disc, so pressing the pedal stops the PTO with the wheels. With the dual clutch, the rear (secondary) disc drives a tubular shaft around the gearbox input shaft. That is geared to a solid shaft running through the hollow countershaft to the hydraulic pump and the PTO. The first half of pedal travel releases only the gearbox disc, so the PTO and hydraulics keep turning (live PTO). Full travel releases both. A lever selects engine-proportional speed (540 rpm at 1,500 engine rpm) or ground speed. (SRC-035 I.1, J.4, M.3)

sections.title: Hydraulic lift

rows.label: System
rows.value: Ferguson System with draft control and position control (twin-lever quadrant)

rows.label: Pump
rows.value: Four-cylinder, constant-running piston pump in the sump between gearbox and final drive. Two piston yokes ride on cam blocks over eccentrics on the pump drive shaft; two opposed valve chambers

rows.label: Pump drive
rows.value: From the PTO drive line, so it stops with the clutch on single-clutch tractors and keeps running on the dual clutch's first stage

rows.label: Lift ram
rows.value: Single-acting ram in the lift cover; 3 in piston from serial 65685

rows.label: Relief valve pressure
rows.value: 2,500 lb/sq in nominal (175.9 kg/sq cm), in the pump outlet gallery. No check valve

rows.label: Oil
rows.value: Drained together with the transmission and rear axle oil through two drain plugs (SRC-035 M.3). A separate hydraulic capacity is not given; transmission fill is 6.6 Imp gal

sections.explainer: Lifting: the pump runs whenever its drive line is turning. Oil goes up a vertical pipe to the closed end of the ram cylinder under the lift cover. The piston is pushed rearwards and rocks the ram arm on the lift shaft. The lift arms on each end of the shaft pull up the lift rods, which raise the lower links. To lower, oil is let out and the weight on the links pushes the piston back (SRC-035 L.5). Draft control: the top link presses on the internal control spring, which moves the control valve so the implement lifts slightly under heavy load. Position control holds the arms at the height set by the lever. (The draft and position summary is still to be checked against the manual's control section.)

rows.label: Levelling
rows.value: Right-hand lift rod adjustable for length by a levelling lever

rows.label: Mountings
rows.value: Lower links pivot on forward ball mountings at the base of the rear axle casing; implement on rear ball ends; check chains limit sway

rows.label: System voltage
rows.value: 12 V from two 6 V batteries in series, 38 Ah (10-hour rate) / 43 Ah (20-hour rate)

rows.label: Dynamo
rows.value: Lucas C39P2, 2-pole, 2-brush, shunt wound, compensated voltage control

rows.label: Starter motor
rows.value: Lucas M45G, 11-tooth pinion on a 113-tooth flywheel ring

rows.label: Cold-start aids
rows.value: CAV Thermostart or Ki-gass (manual). Cold-climate tractors had per-cylinder heater plugs (other sources)

rows.label: Brakes
rows.value: Shoe brakes on the differential shafts, independent pedals

rows.label: Weight (with fuel, oil and water)
rows.value: Basic 3,158 lb (1,432 kg); De Luxe 3,198 lb (1,451 kg)

rows.label: De Luxe equipment
rows.value: Dual clutch, live PTO, Tractormeter and cushion seat

rows.label: Capacities
rows.value: Fuel 7½ Imp gal (34 l); cooling 15 pints (8.5 l); engine sump 12 pints (6.8 l); transmission 6.6 Imp gal (30.28 l); air cleaner ¾ pint; steering 1.8 pints

rows.label: Dimensions
rows.value: Wheelbase 72 in (1,830 mm); length 117 in (2,972 mm); width 64 in (1,630 mm); height 54 in (1,372 mm); track front 48 in, rear 52 in

rows.label: Tyres (as supplied)
rows.value: Front 4 × 19 at 26 psi; rear 10 × 28 at 12 psi

rows.label: Turning circle
rows.value: 17 ft 6 in with independent brakes; 19 ft 3 in without

steps.title: Find the serial plate
steps.text: On the dashboard / instrument console. Its exact position varies by model. Note the full letter prefix and the number.

steps.title: Read the prefix letters
steps.text: 1st letter is the chassis, 2nd is the fuel and 3rd is the clutch. For example, a D in second place means Standard diesel, and an M in third place means dual-stage clutch.

steps.title: Check the engine number
steps.text: Standard engines have no plate. On the diesel, the number is stamped into the block just above the dynamo on the right-hand side. 23C engine numbers run in the form SJ 86045E; the injector type changes at SJ 86046E and SJ 125725E. A 3-cylinder engine is a later Perkins replacement.

steps.title: Check casting dates
steps.text: UK castings carry day/month/year codes. The centre housing code is on the right-hand side, forward of the round port.

steps.title: If the plate is missing
steps.text: The tractor serial was recorded only on the plate. Use casting dates and the engine number. Friends of Ferguson Heritage hold records of UK-built 35s.

steps.title: Test the clutch
steps.text: Engine running, gear in neutral, PTO engaged. Press the clutch slowly to about half travel. If the PTO or hydraulics keep working, it is the dual-stage clutch (live PTO).

identification.prefixNote: The workshop manual (SRC-035 B.1) confirms the FE-35 codes: chassis S, V, J; engine G, H, D, N, K, L; clutch F (single) or M (dual). Other letters come only from a supplier list and may apply to other markets. The Perkins letter is N, not P as that list says. Not yet checked against a known 1958 plate.

glossary.text: A PTO that keeps turning while the gearbox drive is released. On the MF35 it comes from the dual-stage clutch: the first half of pedal travel frees the gearbox only, so the PTO and hydraulic pump keep running; full travel stops both.

Two clutch discs in tandem worked by one pedal: an 11 in disc for the gearbox and a 9 in disc for the PTO and hydraulic pump. Fitted to the De Luxe tractor; the Standard tractor has a single 10 in disc.
A PTO setting in which the shaft is driven from the road-wheel drive line, so it turns in step with the rear wheels (about one revolution per 20 in of travel) instead of with engine speed.
The normal PTO setting: the shaft speed follows engine speed, giving 540 rpm at 1,500 engine rpm.

The hydraulic setting that keeps the pull of a soil-engaging implement steady. The top link presses on the main control spring, which moves the control valve so the implement lifts slightly when the load rises and drops back when it falls.

The hydraulic setting that holds the lift arms at the height chosen with the position lever, whatever the load. A cam on the lift shaft returns the control valve to neutral when the arms reach that height.
A hydraulic cylinder that is pushed by oil in one direction only. The MF35 lift ram raises the arms under pump pressure; to lower, oil is let out and the weight on the links pushes the piston back.
A spring-loaded safety valve in the pump outlet that dumps oil back to the sump when the pressure passes its setting (2,500 lb/sq in nominal), for example when the arms are at the top.

The two lower links and the top link that carry a mounted implement. The lower links take the implement's weight and pull; the top link sets its pitch and feeds the draft load back to the control spring.
The screwed adjuster with a crank handle in the right lift rod. Turning it lengthens or shortens that rod to level the implement from side to side.
The heavy cross shaft in the lift cover. The ram pushes its central arm, and the lift arms splined on each end raise the lift rods.
Fuel is sprayed into a small hot pre-combustion chamber in the head (on the 23C a Ricardo Comet chamber) rather than straight into the cylinder. The burning charge then blows into the cylinder.
A single pumping element with a rotor that sends fuel to each injector in firing order. The 23C uses a CAV DPA pump with a built-in mechanical governor.
The letters before the tractor serial number. The first gives the chassis, the second the fuel, the third the clutch (M = dual-stage). They decide which variant parts fit.
When a part number is replaced by a newer one. The 2008 AGCO numbers shown as replacement references may supersede the original 1958 number from parts book 819045.
A record that differs between versions of the 1958 tractor (for example single or dual clutch) when the version fitted to this tractor has not been confirmed yet.
